utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Wednesday the 25th. Can you all hear me?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah. Am I coming through all right? Bit noisy this end.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: You're fine. There's a sort of humming behind you.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: That's the fan, not me. Haven't had enough coffee to hum.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Same. Kettle's taking longer than the shift handover.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, no Jamie Brennan or Priya Raman today. Just us six.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Before we get into it, the charity bake sale on Friday — apparently there's proper competition over the brownies.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Competition as in baking them or eating them?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Baking. You'd win the other one without much opposition.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Ha. Anyone got weekend plans that don't involve eating? We were thinking of a walk, but the weather looks grim.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: A walk to the pub still counts in the rain.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Forecast changes every time I open it. I've stopped looking.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Probably sensible. Right, Tom, how are the bits from the earlier stand-ups going?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, so I've made a start on the monthly test.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: And the seals on the GT2 inlet valve, I'm about halfway through those.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, cheers.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: The contractor booking for the GT2 Inlet Water Injection Valve is sorted, by the way. All fine.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely, thanks.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: And I signed off the inspection on the number two bearing on Tuesday.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Tuesday? Sorry, the days are merging a bit.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Yeah, yesterday. All signed off.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, onto the new stuff, then.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I'll run a function test on the pop valve by Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: That's you on the pop valve then, Saz? Sorry, you clipped a bit.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, me. I'll have the function test done by Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: I'll inspect the big valve by the gate for leaks, as well. Tomorrow at 9:30.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Tom. Normal priority on that?

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yeah, normal priority. Tomorrow at 9:30 for the inspection.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Tomorrow's Thursday, isn't it? Honestly, ignore me.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: It is. We could put the days on the kettle for you.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cal, can you write up the near miss at the Palletiser?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah — when do you need the write-up in?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: On the 3rd, but that one's safety critical, straight away. I need you starting on it now, not waiting till the 3rd.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Understood. I'll start straight away and get the near miss at the Palletiser written up on the 3rd.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, not one to leave sitting at the bottom of an inbox.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: No, absolutely.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cheers, Cal.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: And I'll do the pre-use checks on the Forklift Fleet tomorrow morning. Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Sorry, spoke over you there, Marc. You said pre-use checks?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll do the pre-use checks on the Forklift Fleet. Normal priority, tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Marc.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Teams just froze on me. Was there something after that?

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: No, just me saying thanks to Marc.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Right, good. Everyone went very thoughtful for a second.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: That's just our faces before nine. Mine's thinking about Friday's cake.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: At least it's for charity. Makes the second slice practically compulsory.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: That's the sort of technical argument I can support.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before this becomes a cake meeting — anything else relevant? Nothing more from me.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Nothing else here.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: No, that's me.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: All good here too.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely. Thanks, everyone. Catch you on the floor.
